references.text: The original command from God to Moses to make fifty bronze hooks to fasten the tent curtains together, so that the tabernacle becomes one.
Describes the fifty gold hooks made for the inner curtains, parallel to the bronze hooks for the outer tent curtains.
The instruction regarding gold hooks for the inner curtains, showing the pattern of using hooks to unite the tabernacle into a whole.
Mentions copper as one of the materials given as an offering for the construction of the tabernacle.
Describes the necessary prerequisite (fastening the curtains in pairs) before the hooks can be inserted to make the tent one.
Describes the loops (loops) which are the necessary counterpart to the hooks for the joining to succeed.
